versions.changelog: Fix: robust heartbeat cleanup (prefer in-run heartbeat); cron heartbeat deliver=false + dedupe + retry cleanup; document python3

Initial release.

- Notifies users before starting long-running tasks (>2–3 minutes).
- Sends a start message with estimated time and heartbeat interval.
- Provides periodic real-time progress updates at a configurable interval (default 5 minutes).
- Immediately notifies user upon task completion or failure.
- Allows users to change heartbeat interval mid-task; updates schedule accordingly.
- Heartbeat includes actual progress and next steps; immediately stops on failure.
